name: rokctapp_composer
description: Configuration list of active SDKs for launch_deliver

sdks.name: base_sdk
sdks._comment: Shared kernel (replaces retired core_sdk); provides the app shell templates.

sdks.name: auth_sdk
sdks._comment: Composed for its library (DI, offline users table) but install.py is skipped: the driver app keeps auth pages host-owned, and its own login page already generates LoginRoute - installing the SDK's route shells would duplicate the name.

sdks.name: productivity_sdk
sdks._comment: Owns tasks (tasks_table, task_service, TasksRoute). launch_sdk's home is tasks-first, so this is the source for that screen and for productivity glance signals - added to match launcher.json and launch_manager.json.

sdks.name: weather_sdk
sdks._comment: Activates the severe-weather banner shipped dormant in zones PR #44: weather 1.4.0's app_type.driver block installs the courier locationResolver wiring plus the weather-driver-configure-location boot hook, and delivery_sdk's home sheet already renders the warnings banner fail-closed. Declaration mirrors driver.json.

sdks.name: revenue_sdk
sdks._comment: Driver income/statistics pages, under a driver/ role folder with an app_type.driver manifest block. Mirrored from driver.json; shared with manager.json, which takes the manager variant from the same SDK.

sdks.name: merchants_sdk
sdks._comment: Story UI the driver app shows; base_sdk already owns story_data/story_request, so only the presentation needed a home.

sdks.name: products_sdk
sdks._comment: restaurant_item / product_item / maps_list widgets used by the driver app.
